task.instruction: Recommend exactly one opening path: display the photograph with a catalog-only public caption, or withhold it and publish a testimony-invitation panel. Then draft the chosen 60–90 word public text and a curator note of at most 60 words. Cite supplied evidence IDs; do not name a possible minor, invent a source, or speak as the photographed person.

evidence.content: Envelope text: Harbor Street tenant meeting, 14 September 1978.
Newspaper caption: L. Ortiz, youth tenant delegate, addresses residents.
A 2026 oral testimony identifies the delegate as Lena Ortiz.
A second 2026 testimony identifies the delegate as Elena Orta.
A synthetic registry indicates Lena Ortiz was 17 on the event date.

The committee permits exactly one opening path this quarter: display the photograph with corroborated catalog facts only, or withhold it and publish the conflicting testimony as an invitation for evidence. No hybrid or second panel is available; no consent to name a possible minor is recorded.
The chosen public surface must be 60–90 words; the nonpublic curator note may be at most 60 words.
An audio archive had one authenticated date, two conflicting speaker attributions, no voice-release form, and one opening slot for either playback or a community evidence call.
A map collection had a verified 1942 survey, two disputed maker records, no consent issue, and one gallery surface for either the map or an attribution-inquiry panel.
